0.imagery: A youth in bright patterned clothes steps toward a cliff edge under a blazing sun, white rose in one hand and a bundle on a staff over the shoulder, while a small white dog leaps at their heels.

1.imagery: A robed figure stands behind a table bearing a wand, cup, sword and pentacle, one hand raised to the sky and one pointed to the earth beneath an infinity symbol, roses and lilies at their feet.

2.imagery: A crowned priestess sits between a black pillar marked B and a white pillar marked J, a pomegranate veil behind her, a crescent moon at her feet, and a scroll reading TORA half-hidden in her lap.

3.imagery: A crowned woman in a starry crown reclines in a field of ripe grain, sceptre in hand and a heart-shaped shield with the Venus sign beside her, a waterfall behind.

4.imagery: A stern bearded king sits on a stone throne carved with rams' heads, holding an orb and an ankh-topped sceptre, bare mountains rising behind him.

5.imagery: A pope-like figure in a triple crown raises two fingers in blessing over two kneeling monks, a triple sceptre in the other hand and two crossed keys at the throne's foot.

6.imagery: A naked couple stands beneath a radiant angel with outstretched arms, the man behind the Tree of Life in flames and the woman before the Tree of Knowledge with its serpent, a bright sun above.

7.imagery: An armored young prince rides a stone chariot canopied with stars, pulled by a black and a white sphinx, a walled city on the riverbank behind.

8.imagery: A woman in a flower crown gently closes a lion's jaws with bare hands, an infinity symbol floating above her head, mountains on the horizon.

9.imagery: A grey-robed old man stands alone on a snowy peak holding a staff and a lantern lit with a six-pointed star, darkness all around.

10.imagery: A great wheel lettered TORA and set with alchemical signs turns among clouds, a sphinx steady on top, a serpent and a dog-headed figure falling and rising at its sides, four winged creatures watching from the corners.

11.imagery: A crowned figure sits upright between two pillars holding balanced scales in one hand and an upright sword in the other, a square clasp at the cloak's neck.

12.imagery: A young man hangs upside down by one ankle from a wooden T-frame, hands behind the back and one leg bent, a calm halo glowing around the head.

13.imagery: A skeletal knight in black armor rides a white horse carrying a black banner with a white rose, a fallen king and a pleading child and maiden in the path, the sun rising between two towers behind.

14.imagery: A winged angel pours water from one cup to another between the hands, one foot on land and one in a pool, a path running to a glowing sun over iris flowers.

15.imagery: A horned, bat-winged figure with an inverted pentagram on the brow looms over a black pedestal to which a naked man and woman are loosely chained, a flaming torch in the raised hand.

16.imagery: Lightning strikes the crown off a stone tower on a rocky peak, flames bursting from the windows as two figures plunge headfirst through the night sky.

17.imagery: A naked woman kneels at a pool pouring water from two jugs, one stream into the water and one onto the land, beneath eight stars with an ibis perched in the tree behind her.

18.imagery: A full moon with a solemn face shines between two towers while a dog and a wolf howl below and a crayfish crawls from the pool onto a winding path.

19.imagery: A naked laughing child rides a white horse beneath a huge friendly sun, a wall of sunflowers behind and a red banner streaming from the small arms.

20.imagery: An angel sounds a trumpet bearing a red-cross banner from the clouds as grey figures rise with outstretched arms from open coffins on the water, mountains behind.

21.imagery: A dancing figure wrapped in a purple sash turns inside a great laurel wreath holding two wands, the bull, lion, eagle and angel watching from the four corners.

22.imagery: A hand emerges from a cloud gripping a thick sprouting wand, a castle on a hill and rolling green slopes below.

23.imagery: A robed figure stands on castle battlements holding a small globe, one hand resting on a planted wand while a second wand stands chained nearby, sea and mountains beyond.

24.imagery: A figure seen from behind stands between three planted wands watching ships sail across calm water toward the horizon.

25.imagery: Two celebrating figures wave flowering bouquets beneath a canopy of four wands strung with a fruit garland, a castle and a happy crowd behind.

26.imagery: Five youths brandish wooden staves at each other in a confused mock battle, all tangled together under a clear blue sky.

27.imagery: A laurel-crowned rider on a white horse carries a wand hung with a victory wreath through a cheering crowd waving their own staves.

28.imagery: A figure on a hilltop grips a staff with both hands, holding the high ground against six staves thrusting up from below.

29.imagery: Eight long staves fly in formation diagonally across an open sky above a river valley, with no people anywhere in sight.

30.imagery: A weary bandaged figure leans on a staff in front of a palisade of eight planted wands, eyes still fixed watchfully ahead.

31.imagery: A bent figure struggles forward carrying a heavy bundle of ten long wands, a walled town visible in the near distance.

32.imagery: A brightly dressed youth stands in a desert holding a tall sprouting wand upright with both hands, three pyramids on the horizon.

33.imagery: An armored knight on a rearing horse charges forward with a raised wand, cloak flying, three small pyramids behind.

34.imagery: A crowned queen sits on a lion-carved throne holding a tall wand and a sunflower, a black cat sitting at her feet.

35.imagery: A crowned king in a salamander-patterned robe sits on a salamander-carved throne, gripping a rough wand and a small flaming salamander amulet.

36.imagery: A hand emerges from a cloud holding an overflowing cup fed by streams of water, a dove carrying a communion wafer diving toward it above a lotus-covered sea.

37.imagery: A man and a woman pledge golden cups to each other beneath a winged lion head crowning a caduceus, a house on green hills behind.

38.imagery: Three women dance in a circle toasting raised cups, fruit and harvest scattered at their feet.

39.imagery: A seated youth with crossed arms ignores three cups standing on the grass while a fourth cup is offered from a floating hand out of a cloud.

40.imagery: A black-cloaked figure stares down at three spilled cups, back turned on two upright cups behind, a bridge leading to a distant castle.

41.imagery: A child hands a flower-filled cup to a smaller child in a walled courtyard where six cups stand brimming with blossoms, a guard with a staff walking away.

42.imagery: A silhouetted figure gazes up at seven cups floating on a cloud, each holding a vision: a castle, jewels, a dragon, a head, a shrouded glowing figure, a snake and a laurel wreath.

43.imagery: A cloaked figure with staff walks away toward barren mountains under a pale moon, leaving eight carefully stacked golden cups behind in the foreground.

44.imagery: A contented merchant sits arms crossed on a bench before nine golden cups arranged in a perfect arch on a draped table.

45.imagery: A couple with open arms and two dancing children rejoice beneath a rainbow arcing ten golden cups over their riverside house.

46.imagery: A dreamy youth in a tasseled tunic stands on a rocky shore holding a cup from which a fish pops its head, waves rolling behind.

47.imagery: An armored knight on a calm white horse steps slowly forward holding out a golden cup, river and green hills on either side.

48.imagery: A crowned queen on a cherub-carved throne by the sea gazes into an ornate lidded cup held with both hands, water stretching to the horizon.

49.imagery: A bearded king sits on a stone throne set in a churning sea, holding a cup and a sceptre, a ship riding the waves and a leaping fish beside him.

50.imagery: A hand emerges from a cloud gripping an upright sword crowned with a golden wreath from which palm and olive branches hang, jagged mountains below.

51.imagery: A blindfolded woman sits on a stone bench at night balancing two crossed swords on her shoulders, a crescent moon over restless water and rocks.

52.imagery: A red heart hangs pierced by three swords beneath heavy rain clouds, with no landscape at all.

53.imagery: A carved knight lies in eternal rest on a stone tomb, hands folded in prayer, three swords hung above and one laid beneath, a stained-glass window glowing behind.

54.imagery: A smirking figure gathers up the fallen swords while two defeated figures walk away toward the sea under broken clouds.

55.imagery: A ferryman poles a flat boat carrying a shrouded woman and child across still water, six swords planted upright in the hull, a far green shore ahead.

56.imagery: A sly figure tiptoes away from a military camp carrying five swords, leaving two planted in the ground, colorful tents behind.

57.imagery: A bound, blindfolded woman stands fenced in by eight swords planted in marshy ground, a castle on a rocky height far behind her.

58.imagery: A figure sits upright in bed at night, face buried in the hands, nine swords hung in a row on the dark wall above a rose-patterned quilt.

59.imagery: A body lies face down on the shore pierced by ten swords along the spine while a black sky breaks into gold above calm water.

60.imagery: A watchful youth stands on a windswept hill gripping an upright sword with both hands, hair and clouds streaming, birds wheeling overhead.

61.imagery: An armored knight on a galloping grey horse charges into a storm with sword raised high, trees bent sideways by the wind.

62.imagery: A stern crowned queen on a cherub-carved throne holds an upright sword in one hand and raises the other in command, butterflies and a single bird in the cloudy sky.

63.imagery: A bearded king sits upright on a butterfly-carved throne holding a great sword straight before him, crescent moons and driven clouds behind.

64.imagery: A hand emerges from a cloud offering a single large golden coin above a blooming garden gate and a path into green hills.

65.imagery: A dancing youth juggles two coins joined in a looping infinity cord while ships ride high rolling waves behind.

66.imagery: A young mason carves a cathedral arch bearing three coins while a monk and a hooded patron study the building plans beside the scaffold.

67.imagery: A crowned figure sits hunched on a stone seat clutching one coin to the chest with coins under both feet and hands, a city behind.

68.imagery: Two ragged beggars limp through falling snow past a warmly lit church window set with five golden coins.

69.imagery: A richly dressed merchant holds balanced scales in one hand and drops coins into the outstretched hands of two kneeling beggars.

70.imagery: A young farmer leans on a staff studying seven coins growing like fruit on a bush in a freshly tilled field.

71.imagery: A focused apprentice hammers a coin at a workbench beneath a row of seven finished coins, an eighth on the bench, a quiet town outside.

72.imagery: An elegant woman with a hooded falcon on her glove stands in a walled vineyard garden where nine golden coins hang among the vines, a small snail at her feet.

73.imagery: A white-bearded elder in a patterned robe sits with two dogs watching a family embrace under a stone arch, ten coins arranged overhead and banners flying from a castle.

74.imagery: A studious youth stands in a green meadow holding a single golden coin up to the light with both hands, mountains on the horizon.

75.imagery: An armored knight sits motionless on a heavy draft horse holding out a single coin, a freshly plowed field stretching behind.

76.imagery: A crowned queen on a goat- and angel-carved throne in a rose garden cradles a large coin, a small rabbit hopping nearby.

77.imagery: A bearded king in grapevine robes sits on a bull-carved throne holding a sceptre and a large coin, a castle and ripe vineyards behind.
